doc: The ONE movement and feel tuning file (owner 11-08), read by scripts/core/locomotion.gd (Loco) for the farm avatar and every match hunter alike. Live: with the movement readout open (F7, or Settings > Controls), saving this file re-reads it within poll_s. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; drags are 1/s (the share of the excess lost per second, exponential). air: accel = how hard WASD pushes in the air; counter = multiplier on accel for the part of your speed going against the keys (a backward drift turns forward in ~0.1 s); side = multiplier for the part going across the keys (bends the arc); drag = how fast speed above your run cap (dash, knock, launch) bleeds in the air; idle_drag = the share of its speed a jump with no keys loses per second ([game data] the reference's falling friction x its braking factor, 0.375 x 2). glide (the pull toward where you steer is [game data], HunterMove.glide_accel): turn / turn_fast = deg/s at cruise and the share kept at the max; brake / brake_deg = pulling back past this angle brakes this hard; drag = how fast speed above cruise bleeds with no keys, drag_steer = the same while steering (owner playtest 11-13 'like the reference': a dash-glide still has >= 10.5 m/s 1 s in, back near cruise in ~3-4 s); coast = m/s^2 a let-go under cruise slows; catch = m/s^2 the canopy eases a fall to its sink rate (absorbed, never turned into speed; ours: the source clamps the fall the step the glider opens, HunterMove.glide_start_vy, and its fastest-fall half is locked); max = the fastest a glide carries; swoop / swoop_fade [game data] GlideDownwardForceSwoopSpeedTransferRatio / SwoopSpeedFadeTime: on a level-out, the fall the glider's own pull or dive built (never a fall you opened it in) becomes swoop x that much forward speed (half while overheated), gone swoop_fade s later (GlideLift). glide_carry: per hunter, speed above this carried from Shift into a glide bleeds at carry_drag (on top of drag), so a dash never turns into a long sprint. dash.jump_keep: the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps (the rest is air drag's, Loco.air_step; 1 = all of it, a long dash-jump). dash_glide (scripts/match/dash_glide.gd, owner 11-11 'a weird hitch when i shift->glider'): ease_t = s, the time constant a kit's cut of an air dash's speed eases out over instead of one step; grace = s after an air dash a fresh glide press still counts as a press in the dash and opens the glider at once, past the kit's wind-down (per hunter, under WINDOW 0.3; juggernaut 0.25: owner playtest 11-13, Brall's dash + glide must not wait out his 0.35 s wind-down; the source's patch 05.02.25 had none right after his dash). press_buffer: s a press made too early still goes when it becomes allowed, the one window players feel for all three: past a dash's end while the hunter can't act (DashFlow), before a two-step's recast arms (ArchKit), before a crowd control ends (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0022); a cast-lock press buffer reads it too, and a kit that needs another window keeps a per-kit override with its source; source: owner 11-08 'recasts buffered ~0.15 s' (DECISIONS two-step abilities), the footage gives no field (decision 0026). dash_speed: per hunter, a dash's speed scale (its time stretches so the distance stays); the shape of a dash (ease in, peak, skid) is the hunter's source curve in content/rules/dash_feel.json. sources: notes only (never read as numbers): where each glide/air value comes from, settled or Not determinable with the frames (sv/FEEL.md).

sources.doc: Where each glide/air number comes from (SUPERVIVE_FEEL.md 'Footage pass', Nov 12 2026). Notes only, nothing here is read as a number. Trust order: owner > game data > wiki > footage.
sources.glide_cruise: SETTLED 5.0 m/s x body_scale = 5.8 m/s (HunterMove.glide_cruise): [game data] MaxGlide 500 uu/s; [footage] ~5 m/s, run pace. Agree; at our body scale like the walk (decision 0061).
sources.glide_base_speeds: Not determinable (GlideInitial*/TargetXY* encrypted): glide.drag/drag_steer/max are ours. No player glide start in the hero-ref clips; Elluna 706.8 s dash-into-glide still decaying (11 -> 8 m/s) when the track ends.
sources.glide_gravity: Not determinable (GlideGravityFactor encrypted): Hunter.GLIDE_SINK 1.4 m/s is ours; footage shows only the height hold (Tom Kick ~14 s level) and lift (Zik ~1 s back up).
sources.glide_braking: Not determinable (GlideBraking* encrypted): glide.coast and glide.brake/brake_deg are ours. Tetra guide 300 s and showcase 1174 s frame-stepped: no player let-go or back-key brake.
sources.hoop_boost: Not determinable (GlideBoost* encrypted): no hoop or jetstream in any hero-ref clip.
sources.jump_hold: Not determinable: a key hold is not visible on screen. Owner: fixed jump, Space held never opens the glider.
sources.air_dash: Per Hunter (AirDashSpeedMultiplier/Clamp encrypted): Shiv ~1.7x ground (8.4 m / 0.95 s, dancer.md 303.8-304.5 s, 0129-0134), carried to the landing; Elluna 11-15 m / 0.8-1.1 s (mooshmoosh.md 731.1/706.8/735.9/745.1 s) = tender dash.air; Kingpin card 'further', air_k 1.35 est; the other nine: Not determinable, no air dash in their clips.

reticle._about: The cursor reticle (scripts/ui/reticle.gd, reticle_hud.gd). px at size 1 unless a key says otherwise.

lace._note: Lace's bow feel (PinDraw), owner 11-08: perfect_window_s = how long after a draw stage comes up a release is still perfect (the source's is about 0.15 s; the owner asked for about 0.2 s more); perfect_glow_rim / perfect_glow_col = the toon rim amount and hex colour on her body and bow while the window is open; perfect_payoff_rim / perfect_payoff_s = the stronger rim and its length in s on a perfect release.

tenzo._note: Tenzo (dolm). r_floor: the slab of rock ground his R (Basalt Spine) raises under him on the press, the same frame (BreahSpine.floor_under): r m round him (abyss tiles only turn to ground), time s it lasts, warn s of cracks and shake before it crumbles, rise s the slab takes to heave up (the ground is solid at once), col its stone. rmb: Quakefall's held hop (BreahSlam): windup s planted in a deep crouch before take-off, hop_up m/s up off the ground, fall_k the gravity multiplier on the way down (a thrown stone drops hard), ease how much faster than its average the hop leaves the ground (its ground speed eases to nil at the landing), carry the share of his run the hop keeps, nudge m/s the move keys bend its ground speed by, dive_hang s he hangs at the top of an air press over the abyss before the plunge, dive_acc m/s^2 the plunge speeds up at toward its cap; air_reach m the air press's arc carries him toward the cursor at most (owner 11-26: it plunged straight down; the reference's closest moves travel 2.2-3.3 m), air_up m/s it pops him up first, air_fall_k the gravity multiplier on its way down.

feel.doc: The match hunter's ledge, abyss, glide, drop, dive and landing numbers (HunterFeel, scripts/match/hunter_feel.gd; were consts in hunter.gd). Read once at load, not live.

notes.spirit_climb: m/s a Spirit Walk rises up a ledge face (Phase Walk goes through raised terrain)
notes.air_decel: let go on a ledge rise and you mostly stop
notes.air_overspeed: but momentum above run speed (a dash, a pad) still carries
notes.glide_grav: [O] m/s^2, gravity while a glider is open and the heat is gone
notes.glide_engage: scripted input only (checks, demos): hold glide this long in the air and it opens. A player's keys never hold-open it (glide_press_only) (the dedicated glide button, Mouse 5, opens it at once)
notes.abyss_lift: [est] upward pull (m/s^2) just under the lip...
notes.abyss_lift_per_m: [est] ...plus this per metre deeper (10m down: 92 m/s^2)
notes.abyss_lift_max: [est] fastest climb just under the lip...
notes.abyss_lift_max_per_m: [est] ...plus this per metre deeper (12m down: ~18 m/s; item 63: ~30% under the old ~25)
notes.abyss_lift_cap: item 63: the deepest climb is 30% softer than the old 26
notes.abyss_brake_dist: ...that brakes near ground level (let go just before to keep the height)
notes.abyss_brake: [E] m/s^2, the brake that slows the lift in its last abyss_brake_dist
notes.abyss_lip_vy: [est] m/s still rising as the lift reaches the lip: it bounces up past it
notes.abyss_brake_gain: (movefeel) rise speed per metre left in the brake zone (was 2: the last metre crawled)
notes.mantle_reach: [game data] MantleSuctionUpwardsForceHeightMax: a lip this far above you pulls you up
notes.tall_climb_extra: m: Archer and Juggernaut also climb double-high ledges ([game data] bCanWallJump)
notes.mantle_reach_abyss: below an island's lip over the abyss, its side catches you this far down (movefeel: was 3.5) (a bit past the normal ledge reach); deeper you slide down the face
notes.wall_catch_reach: (movefeel) over the abyss below a lip, a wall this far from your side catches you (elsewhere 0.4)
notes.abyss_glide_room: a glider with heat left (lifting you out) gets this much more room
notes.ledge_reach: [E] m, a ledge this far above you can be climbed (walk into it)
notes.float_speed: [E] m/s, the fastest a float (a lift's hang at the top) carries you sideways
notes.glide_fall: [O] m/s, the glider's sink with fuel (the readout's number)
notes.dive_speed: m/s, top flat speed in the dive (DropFeel)
notes.drop_fall: [E] m/s, the open glider's sink in the opening drop
notes.drop_speed: m/s, top flat speed under the open glider
notes.dive_vy_rate: the dive reaches its fall speed in ~0.3s (was 4)
notes.drop_vy_rate: the canopy settles to its sink in ~0.2s after it opens (was 4)
notes.deploy_pop: the canopy catching: your fall checks to this, then settles to DROP_FALL
notes.deploy_h: the glider opens by itself this high above the ground
notes.feather_keep: [est] seconds after a glider close that count as just off it (ledges, wall shove)
notes.feather_min: [est] the glider reopens with this much heat room left (was 0.15)
notes.feather_tap: [est] an abyss lift's quick first seconds, heating at HunterMove.lift_tap_heat
notes.lrise_speed: [footage] the fastest rise from deep in the abyss (HunterMove.rise_vy)
notes.lrise_min: [est] up speed walking into a ledge starts its rise with
notes.lrise_pop: [est] up speed as you clear the lip with no jump (a ~0.25m pop)
notes.lrise_off: moved this far out from the face: you've let go
notes.lrise_window: [est] the fling window: the last this-many metres below the top (~0.12s)
notes.fling_early_height: [est] a jump before the window, or on a ledge taller than hunter_move.json mantle_mini_h: only just over the top. The timed fling and the cooldown are hunter_move.json physics mantle_mini_* / mantle_cd [game data]
notes.abyss_extra: [game data] AbyssHeight: lost 17.5m under ground level (with World.ABYSS_DEPTH)
